title: Solitonic Construction of Artificial Neural Networks from Nonlinear Field Theory
summary: We present a field-theoretic construction of a class of artificial neural networks from solitonic degrees of freedom in nonlinear scalar field theory. The purpose is not to rename a standard neural layer in the language of solitons, but to start from a continuum action, restrict the theory to a nonperturbative sector containing localized stable solutions, perform a collective-coordinate reduction, and derive the neural layer as the finite-dimensional input-output map of the reduced solitonic dynamics.
